findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "stork_call" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "stork_server_details" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
